The New Testament manuscripts preserve multiple spellings (Nazareth, Nazaret, Nazara), reflecting Semitic-to-Greek transliteration variation rather than different locations. Luke places the Annunciation there (1:26), and Matthew identifies it as the fulfillment of a prophetic word: 'He shall be called a Nazarene' (2:23).
